plan.subject: Understand the foundational concepts of haptics and their role in touch perception and manipulation.
plan.objective: Understand the foundational concepts of haptics and their role in touch perception and manipulation.

blocks.title: Touch Perception
blocks.teachingObjective: Touch perception is the basis for understanding how humans interact with physical objects through touch.
examples: Human ability to distinguish textures and shapes through touch

blocks.title: Kinesthetic Feedback
blocks.teachingObjective: Kinesthetic feedback is essential for understanding how the body senses movement and force during interaction.
examples: Feedback from muscle and joint movement during object manipulation

blocks.title: Haptic Feedback Systems
blocks.teachingObjective: Haptic feedback systems are the technological realization of touch perception and kinesthetic feedback in machines.
examples: Devices that simulate tactile sensations through vibrations or force

blocks.title: Applications of Haptics
blocks.teachingObjective: Applications demonstrate the practical importance of haptics in real-world scenarios.
examples: Use in virtual reality, robotics, and medical training
